title: The Glazier
subtitle: hideDetailsUntilStartable -- and a dependency on the old name
description: The glazier's trade is lenses for looking at things the province
would rather were not looked at, and the stall keeps its prices
hidden until it is actually open to you:
`hideDetailsUntilStartable` withholds a quest's task and reward
details until it can be started, while leaving the prerequisites
visible -- which are, the glazier points out, the part that tells
Its dependency is written against `the_old_name` -- the stall's
former id -- and resolves exactly as the id would.
